text:
nina_csm: Alerting the group  Pulse: DataCare tokens/day down ~90% over 8d. Renewal in 12 days. Their PM left last week; procurement is asking for a competitor proof-of-concept. Need immediate triage and a retention play.

monitor-bot: Automated alert: customer=DataCare, metric=tokens_8d, change=-90%, active_seats=8->2, error_rate=0.5%->6.2%, recent_deploy=2026-03-11. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/customers/datacare/health

omar_sales: I'm on procurement thread  they mentioned "unreliable responses" and that SiphonAI offered a 10-day pilot. I'll lead commercial outreach. Do we have quick perf/cost bullets to send?

tess_eng: Quick triage checklist: (1) check per-key activity last 14d, (2) error histogram, (3) inspect recent model routing change (we rolled a smaller KV cache variant on 3/11). Can someone surface any failing req ids?

ryan_ops: Billing logs show their seat count dropped from 8->2 on 2026-03-15 via an automated admin job; possible accidental deprovision. Also saw a spike in avg tokens per call from ~300 -> ~9k starting 3/12.

monitor-bot: Query summary: top_errors=502(55%), 429(30%), 401(15%). Top_api_key last active 2026-03-16. Peak 502s correlate with payload spikes 3/12-3/14.

nina_csm: I'm scheduling a 20m call with their interim PM in 15m to get failing ids and confirm whether they rotated keys or toggled any feature flags.

omar_sales: I'll prep a short counter-offer: 7-day microburst (3x throughput) + 1-hour pairing session + a post-trial performance scorecard. Need finance approval if estimated credit > $4k. Tagging @chris_fin.

tess_eng: If payload spikes are true we can throttle large batches server-side with a clear guidance error and enable a temporary higher memory pool for their account. Also will check whether the rolled KV-cache variant regressed for their model shape.

(nina_csm): On the call now  interim PM provided two failing ids: req_20260313_f7 and req_20260314_z2 and said their infra toggled a new export feature on 3/12 that increased batch sizes. They also rotated keys on 3/16 but didn't tell app owners.

tess_eng: Received ids. Quick triage: req_20260313_f7 -> 502 (OOM on router due to large payload), req_20260314_z2 -> 429 (per-key quota exceeded), consistent with batch-size change + partial key rotation. Root cause: rollout artifact.

ryan_ops: Immediate mitigations implemented: restored admin seats, whitelisted PM IP for pairing, temporarily bumped per-key burst x3 for confirmed new key, and toggled a safety throttle on payloads >5k tokens with a helpful error message.

omar_sales: Sent counter-offer email: 7-day microburst at 3x baseline, complimentary 1-hr tech pairing, written performance targets for the window. Asked for acceptance within 24h.

chris_fin: Estimated cost for 7-day microburst (3x) ~$3.9k. Finance approves unilateral credit under $5k. Proceed.

nina_csm: Post-actions: added renewal-risk tag, created playbook with owners and due dates, scheduled 3-day check-in.

monitor-bot: 6h snapshot: tokens/day recovered to 78% baseline after quota bump and throttle + pairing scheduled. Error rate down to 1.1%. Recommend 48h monitor and QBR prep.

omar_sales: Procurement paused SiphonAI pilot pending our microburst. If we execute cleanly this should materially reduce churn risk. Will update when customer accepts in writing. :thumbsup:
